thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — during the periodic least-privilege audit I saw 18 principals still bound to `role/admin-legacy` with KMS permissions. some look orphaned. starting triage now.

zara: can you drop the query you used?

maria:```sql
SELECT principal, role, last_used, last_owner_evidence
FROM entitlement.snapshot_2026_q2
WHERE role = 'admin-legacy' AND resource_type = 'kms'
ORDER BY last_used DESC;
```

tony: oof, `last_owner_evidence` null for many. i'll run a quick last-used distribution: ```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, DATE(last_used) AS d
FROM entitlement.snapshot_2026_q2
WHERE role='admin-legacy' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC;
```

lee: infra note: we had an intermittent consumer lag on the ownerproof pipeline on 2026-04-27 01:20-02:45 UTC. infra-bot logged a replay but that replay only touched compute logs, missed a small KMS shard.

infra-bot: replay_job id=rp-20260427-03 status=completed files=912 range=2026-04-27T01:20:00Z..2026-04-27T02:45:00Z (shard=3 flagged)

maria: that explains some gaps. can we backfill the missing shard?

infra-bot: shard rehydrate requested RH-20260427-03 status=queued. cold retrieval may take ~2h.

zara: while we wait, propose we build a second-evidence pass: 1) PR metadata cross-check, 2) service-actor key rotation history, 3) manager attestation. i'll sketch a script to correlate PRs and grant times.

tony: also flagging items with `last_used > 90d` for immediate rotation. we should auto-rotate service account keys for those.

vendor-ops: pinged vendor contacts for two vendor SAs that appear in the set. they claim ownership but need to provide PR link or owner email.

maria: create incident for audit record and compliance: INC-2026-305 "Entitlement evidence gaps during quarterly audit". priority: P3.

sec-bot: [automated] INC-2026-305 created and assigned to eng-security. add followups to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-305

lee: rehydrate complete: RH-20260427-03 status=success files=1,042 bytes=1.3GB. kicking ownerproof collector: `tools/ownerproof/collect --window 2026-04-27T01:20:00Z/2026-04-27T02:45:00Z --roles admin-legacy`

infra-bot: collector run cr-20260427-11 started.

zara: meanwhile i pushed a lightweight PR to the collector to also join `git_metadata.prs` and `entitlement.grants` on timestamp fuzzy match. PR #976.

tony: collector cr-20260427-11 finished: events=62 proofs_recovered=9. updated entitlement queue.

maria: good progress. remaining principals without proof: 9 (6 service accounts, 2 humans, 1 external contractor).

zara: for the service accounts, if ownerproof missing by EOD we should rotate keys and apply least-priv role mapping (`admin-legacy` -> `kms-operator` or `kms-reader` depending on use). create a JIT access path for owners to re-request privileges.

maria: agreed. action list: (A) vendor attestation outreach (vendor-ops) (B) rotate orphaned svcacct keys + reduce role (tony) (C) manual manager attest for humans (zara) (D) update collector to PR-join (lee + zara).

vendor-ops: vendor attestation received for one SA, waiting on the other. provided PR link: git/repo/infra/merge/4123.

sec-bot: compliance note: wildcard bindings or legacy roles touching KMS are flagged as elevated risk. recommend patching infra module to forbid `admin-legacy` in future onboarding.

maria: filed infra ticket INFRA-1282 to block `admin-legacy` from new role bindings and to require `sensitive:kms` tag for manual attestation.

tony: starting rotation for 6 orphaned SAs in canary (region us-central1). plan: rotate key -> deploy with new SA creds to canary -> monitor decrypt errors 30m -> rotate global. run id: rot-20260502-07.

lee: added an alert: `entitlement.missing_evidence_count > 5 for 24h` -> create auto-incident. opening PR for metric in infra.

maria: excellent. closing loop: update INC-2026-305 with recovered proofs and remediation steps (collector PR, INFRA-1282, rotation run ids). we'll keep this thread as the running log for the clean-up. reconvene tomorrow for sign-off.

zara: quick note for postmortem: root cause = partial shard miss during ownerproof ingestion + legacy role creep. remediation: shard-level rehydrate automation, collector PR for PR-join, onboarding module guardrails.

maria: thanks team. leaving entitlement removals paused until attestation/rotation complete. :thumbsup:
